slots.jd.freight-startup.about: We're Tidewater Freight Labs, and we help shippers see where their freight is right now. We need an Engineering Manager to lead our backend team, keep our tracking APIs fast and reliable, and help decide what we build next. You'll still read code, review designs and get your hands dirty when it counts. The role is fully remote within the US.
slots.jd.freight-startup.duties:
What you'll do
- Lead API design and versioning so partners can integrate without surprises
- Automate our deployment pipeline from commit to production
- Track down slow queries and tune them before customers notice
- Run code reviews and mentor the engineers on your team
- Own the backend roadmap together with product and operations
slots.jd.freight-startup.needs:
What we're looking for
- 13 or more years of backend software experience, including time leading a team
- Hands-on work building Spring Boot services and shipping them with Docker
- Experience setting up and maintaining CI pipelines in Jenkins
- Comfort running PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch in production
- Solid Linux skills for debugging live systems

slots.r1.b4: Reviews GraphQL resolver code and mentors engineers on schema design, query cost and testing practices.
slots.r1.b5: Moves services onto Kubernetes with health checks and autoscaling, lowering after-hours pages by 50 percent.

slots.r1.i2: Manages the engineering team at Maple Court Care and owns incident follow-up, turning each outage review into updated runbooks and tracked fixes.

slots.summary.1: Lead backend engineer with 13 years of experience building services with GraphQL, Redis and Docker. Leads an engineering team and owns the technical roadmap for its area, from API design to deployment and reliability.
